name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the SDK (elevenlabs + python-dotenv), created example.py with the documented code, and successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs API. The output.mp3 file is 41,839 bytes and verified as a real MPEG ADTS Layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz.
